_readme: Add your affiliate partner tools here.
The article generator will prioritize these tools in content naturally.
The sync-affiliate-links workflow auto-updates tools-data.js with your affiliate URLs,
so the client-side auto-linker uses your tracking links instead of plain homepages.
name          — Exact display name (must match how it appears in articles)
affiliate_url — Your tracking/referral URL for this tool
categories    — Used to bias roundup/tutorial topics toward this tool's niche
priority      — 1 = highest (mentioned most often), 2 = normal, 3 = secondary
